description: Search BlackOps notes and blog posts. Returns id, title, and url per match; pass an id to fetch for the full text. Generated daily notes (note_type "daily", titled "YYYY-MM-DD · {Name}") do not contain the word "daily" in their title — queries containing "daily" automatically include them via a supplementary typed lookup, but for reliable lookup by context name use list_notes with note_type: "daily" and search: "{name}", or list_daily_note_configs to see which contexts exist.

domain.description: Site domain. Defaults to the account default site.

query.description: Search terms, matched against titles and bodies.

name: search
title: Search
